visualCharacteristics.purpose: In-page legal/disclaimer columns placed above the site footer, plus a social-icon link row

contentPattern.structure: one row with 2 cells; each cell holds uppercase section labels followed by disclaimer paragraphs with inline links. With `social`, a single cell holds a list (or run) of icon links to social profiles

usage: Appears on almost every page (679 pages) as the pre-footer issuer/disclaimer text and the social links strip.
reuseGuidance: Use for dense legal or disclaimer text split into columns near the page foot. Use `social` for the icon-only social profile links. The global site footer is built separately by the footer orchestrator.
